name: Gillette India Limited
summary: Gillette India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of grooming and oral care products in India and internationally. It offers shaving system and cartridges, blades, toiletries, razors, and other components. The company also offers toothbrushes and oral care products. In addition, the company provides body shaving and trimming; skin care; and shaving gel, shaving cream & after shave; and female grooming products under the Venus brand name. The company sells its products primarily under the GilletteLabs, SkinGuard Sensitive, Fusion5, MACH3, Disposable Razor, Guard3, and Styler brand names. Gillette India Limited markets and sells its products through mass merchandisers, grocery stores, membership club stores, drug stores, department stores, and high frequency stores. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
